description: Checks that the sum of column 6B (total hours x total fringe $/h, per worker) equals the fringe paid to the four plans (health and welfare, pension, vacation/holiday, training: total hours x plan rate). reconciles = |sum of 6B - sum of plans| < 0.005. Takes the same worker entries as wh347_payroll_lines (only hours and fringe rates matter here).

workers.description: One entry per worker-week on one project, in WH-347 line order.

cash_in_lieu_rate.description: Cash paid in lieu of fringe, $/h (column 6C).

gross_all_work.description: Gross earned for all work, column 7B. Omitted or null = 7A.

ot_hours.description: Overtime hours, day 1 to 7, paid at base rate x 1.5 (missing days = 0).

st_hours.description: Straight-time hours, day 1 to 7 of the payroll week (missing days = 0).

type.description: Column 2: J (journeyworker), RA (registered apprentice) or empty.

name: wh347_fringe_reconcile
title: WH-347 column 6B fringe reconciliation
